note: Triennial election of the rural district council, polled on Thursday 1 June 1967. Four divisions were contested (Antrim Rural, Ballyrobin, Crumlin, Seacash; already held). The returning officer's Notice of Result has not been found in BNA, so most uncontested divisions remain unnamed. Sitting member for Antrim Rural, nominated unopposed for the town seat (Antrim Urban) after Sam Anketell did not seek re-election; no withdrawals affected the contests. Returned unopposed.
